task.problem: Python Agent TASK-256 r1 was authorized at downstream main 2a773fd11636223b71f0b224523e0cef7915c07a with exact repository policy .ai/executor-profiles.yaml and resolved Codex profile gpt-6-sol/high. Its first post-sync PRIMARY attempt created canonical RUN-256-001, persisted the exact execution profile sidecar, then failed at COMPLETION_GATE before native Executor implementation. The canonical failure artifact commit is e0e721aad9959880de464705a225e87c9c19820d; failed_head_sha equals the base, changed_files is empty, dirty=false, descends_from_base=true, repairable=true and transportable=true. The error path was execution-profile policy lookup under the transient installed worker runtime: ...worker-runtime/Lib/.ai/executor-profiles.yaml. Audit of current AIOS-renew main confirms src/aios_renew/dispatch_reconciliation.py still calls validate_profile_identity() from _read_record() without supplying repository or policy context. For a source-installed AIOS checkout this is masked by the package tree's own .ai policy; for an installed package governing an external repository it resolves the wrong policy root. PRIMARY v3 durable record read/bind/replay/status therefore has a portability defect even though operator authorization already resolved the exact repository-owned profile correctly. REMEDIATION and REPAIR dispatch paths already carry explicit repository policy context and must not be redesigned by this task.
